measurement: Post-batch CodeQL multiset resolution. Partial duplicate groups stay ambiguous. Joint security requires resolved, no new alerts, no new ordinary test failures, passing behavioral assertions. Missing evidence is null.
test_classification: Exact frozen test IDs only; unlisted failures count as regressions.
implementation_selection_note: Final corrected harness, selected by code identity rather than outcome. Earlier warm-up implementations are retained and analyzed separately. This record is not an independent preregistration.
cohort_selection: The new free plan uses Gemini-3.6-flash alongside 3.1/3.5 Flash Lite and the two local Qwen models. Gemma-26B returned HTTP 500; Gemma-31B completed one pilot then returned repeated HTTP 500/503. Flash 3.6 completed three cells before its observed 20-requests-per-day free quota was exhausted. Access failures are not model repair failures.
latest_code_note: The target-environment validator correction is a separate implementation, audited on a saved candidate. Keep its future runs under new tags and separate implementation hashes.
